documentation.content: A call to the owner console's callables was refused for a reason other than NOT_OWNER, SIGN_IN or RATE_LIMITED (`owner_call_refused`: `function`, `reason`, `uidHash`). Those reasons are reached only past the owner check, so they come from a listed owner's session: `RECENT_SIGN_IN`, `STALE`, `CONFIRM_SENSITIVE`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `INVALID_VALUE`, `UNKNOWN_SETTING`, `STORED_INVALID`, `INVALID_RESULT`, `WEB_LIMIT` (a change outside what the page may make), and the profile switch's `NOT_READY`, `UNKNOWN_PROFILE`, `PRICES_INVALID`. Your own mistyped saves or an expired sign-in explain a few; if you were not using the console, someone may be in your browser session: sign out everywhere (revoke the Google session), remove the account from `config/owner`, and read `ownerSettingChanges/` and `providerProfileChanges/` in the Firestore console. See functions/README.md, "The owner console".

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.message="owner_call_refused" AND NOT jsonPayload.reason=("NOT_OWNER" OR "SIGN_IN" OR "RATE_LIMITED")
